Security Council Record is an independent record of every resolution, vote and veto of the United Nations Security Council since 1946. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the United Nations. For official documents, use the Security Council website and the UN Digital Library.

Built on the documentation of the Security Council, the CR-UNSC corpus (Fobbe, Gasbarri and Ridi, CC0), the UN machine-readable resolutions and the UNSC votes since 1946 database (Sciences Po Atelier de cartographie and GRAM, CC BY 4.0). Method and sources.

Made by Daniel D'Esposito with Claude. About this project. Data and code are open. Free to reuse under CC BY 4.0 with credit. Designed to work on any phone and with screen readers.
